req.title: Redirect-to accepts POST as well
req.statement: The system shall accept POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH, and TRACE on /redirect-to.

doc.reasoning: The redirect_to handler at /redirect-to accepts GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH, and TRACE. The source reads 'url' from request.args (query string) for all methods, and sets status_code from args if 300<=code<400. Tests must cover: (1) positive EP for each non-GET method (POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH, TRACE) returning 302 with correct Location; (2) negative path for missing 'url' param causing KeyError/500; (3) boundary BVA for status_code at 300 (inclusive), 299 (below threshold), and 399 (inclusive upper-1), 400 (exclusive). Each test is self-contained, uses Flask test_client, and asserts exact values to kill mutations on operator flips and constant changes.

tests.name: test_redirect_to_post_returns_302_with_location
trace: R-HTTPBIN-028: POST on /redirect-to shall return 302 redirect
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_to_post_returns_302_with_location():
    r = client.post('/redirect-to?url=http://example.com')
    assert r.status_code == 302
    assert r.headers['Location'] == 'http://example.com'

test_redirect_to_post_returns_302_with_location()

tests.name: test_redirect_to_all_methods_return_302_default
preconditions: all five non-GET methods tested in one suite
actions: POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH, TRACE each to /redirect-to?url=http://x.com
trace: R-HTTPBIN-028: all listed methods must produce 302 with correct Location
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_to_all_methods_return_302_default():
    methods_and_callers = [
        ('POST', client.post),
        ('PUT', client.put),
        ('DELETE', client.delete),
        ('PATCH', client.patch),
    ]
    for method_name, caller in methods_and_callers:
        r = caller('/redirect-to?url=http://x.com')
        assert r.status_code == 302, f'{method_name} expected 302 got {r.status_code}'
        assert r.headers['Location'] == 'http://x.com', f'{method_name} bad Location'
    r = client.open('/redirect-to?url=http://x.com', method='TRACE')
    assert r.status_code == 302
    assert r.headers['Location'] == 'http://x.com'

test_redirect_to_all_methods_return_302_default()
